seriesName: Significant reforms planned on IoT/M2M
dataNote: While there are no significant reforms planned, work continues to accommodate IoT/M2M via updates to current regulatory frameworks. Examples include recent updates to the LIPD class licence which accommodates a various of short-range devices and the provision of 2 × 5 MHz (2005–2010 MHz paired with 2195–2200 MHz) dedicated for satellite IoT and similar narrowband services to be used on a shared basis between operators.•Further information available here:•Draft Five Year Spectrum Outlook – ACMA•New arrangements for low interference potential devices - consultation 28/2020 - ACMA•Replanning the 2 GHz band (1980–2010 and 2170– 2200 MHz) outcomes paper - ACMA
